patterns.note: Content sections alternate between full-width white backgrounds and full-width vibrant purple backgrounds, creating distinct visual breaks.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for primary messaging, contrasted with smaller, lighter-weight body text and uppercase navigation labels.
A vibrant purple (#6F38F5) is used as a strong accent color for calls-to-action and entire content sections, providing high contrast against dark and light backgrounds.

The hero section features a dynamic video background that changes its visual content as the user scrolls, while the main navigation bar becomes sticky and gains a solid dark background after scrolling past the hero.
Feature content is presented in a three-column grid of card-like elements, each containing an image, title, and descriptive text, with a subtle rounded border.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background that dynamically changes its visual content based on scroll depth or a pre-defined sequence, with a dark overlay to ensure text readability. The main navigation bar is initially transparent over the hero and then transitions to a sticky position with a solid dark background color as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections are designed with alternating full-width background colors (white and a vibrant purple) to visually segment the page. Within these sections, content is often structured into multi-column grids using card-like containers with subtle rounded corners and internal padding.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, regular-weight body text and uppercase navigation items.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and images, maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with airy sections for the hero and 'Follow us' section, and a more structured, slightly denser grid for feature cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, changing video background in the hero section, which shifts its visual content as the user scrolls, immediately captures attention. This, combined with the bold application of a vibrant purple accent color for entire content blocks, makes the design feel energetic and modern, moving beyond typical marketing site layouts.
